description:
T13  - Aesculus hippocastanum:
Reduce crown by specified extent - height and branch length by up to approximately  2m to relieve wind loading and minimise risk of either branch or stem failure. Final cuts to be made at suitable growth points or at pre-existing pollard points, continued management of pollard tree.

T14 - Acer pseudoplatanus:
Lift low canopy, highways clearance - that is growing over the road at approx 8m.

T15 - Acer pseudoplatanus:
Lift low canopy, highways clearance - that is growing over the road at approx. 8m.

T16 - Ailanthus altissima:
Reduce crown by specified extent - height and branch length by up to approximately  2m to relieve wind loading and minimise risk of either branch or stem failure. Final cuts to be made at suitable growth points or at pre-existing pollard points, continued management of pollard tree.
Remove debris/vegetation - and provide access (of 1 m minimum) around the full circumference of the trunk to facilitate decay investigations.

T17 - Ailanthus altissima:
Reduce crown by specified extent - height and branch length by up to approximately  2m to relieve wind loading and minimise risk of either branch or stem failure. Final cuts to be made at suitable growth points or at pre-existing pollard points, continued management of pollard tree.
Remove debris/vegetation - and provide access (of 1 m minimum) around the full circumference of the trunk to facilitate decay investigations.

T18 - Cerasus avium:
Prune from adjacent structure - to clear building by 1 m.
